Exercise: On Your Side Quad Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- extension
- unilateral_hip_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_flexibility_in_the_quadriceps_and_hip_flexors

Contraindications:

- recent hip surgery
- severe hip pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Start off by lying on your right side, with your right knee bent at a 90-degree angle resting on the floor in front of you (this stabilizes the torso).
- Bend your left knee behind you and hold your left foot with your left hand. To stretch your hip flexor, press your left hip forward as you push your left foot back into your hand. Switch sides.
